items.title: Updating our coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy timelines
items.summary_en: The update addresses overly long vulnerability disclosure timelines by shortening the coordinated disclosure window from 90 days to 30 days for high- and critical-severity issues, and to 45 days for all others. This faster deadline aims to pressure vendors to remediate serious flaws more quickly and reduce the window of exposure for users.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌将协调漏洞披露政策的时间线从统一90天缩短为：高危和严重漏洞30天、其他问题45天，以加快修复和披露节奏。这一调整旨在减少高危漏洞的暴露窗口，促使供应商更快响应，从而降低用户和生态系统的安全风险。
items.title_en: Updating our coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy timelines

items.title: QwenLM/qwen-code: Release v0.27.3-nightly.20261115.6e3b2dcc19
items.summary_en: This release for Qwen Code improves workspace navigation and managed agent reliability by adding a sidebar workspace filter to the web shell and a DingTalk adapter for managed channels. It also fixes a recovery issue so stale public-child processes are terminated instead of retried indefinitely, preventing resource waste and hangs.
items.summary_zh: Qwen Code 的 v0.27.3-nightly 版本主要改进了工作区管理与托管代理的稳定性：为 Web Shell 增加侧边栏工作区过滤器，并在托管通道中接入钉钉适配器，便于企业沟通集成。同时修复了托管代理对过期公共子进程的恢复策略，将其改为终止而非无限重试，从而避免资源浪费和系统卡死。
